summary: Seven games were played on Saturday, and the listed home team won four of them. Stephen Curry scored a night-high 41 as Golden State beat Orlando 126-119 in overtime, and Donovan Mitchell had 37 in Cleveland's loss to New York. Oklahoma City's 114-75 win over Washington was the largest margin at 39 points, and Atlanta came back from 17 down to beat Brooklyn 124-121.

games.headline: Nuggets build a 27-point lead and beat Pacers 114-102
games.story: Denver scored 37 in the second quarter and led 64-41 at halftime, with the lead reaching 27 at 64-37 late in the period. Indiana won the third quarter 37-26 and cut it to 12 at 90-78, but never got closer. Nikola Jokic had 19 points, 13 rebounds and 8 assists, Cameron Johnson scored 18 and Jamal Murray had 16 points and 8 assists. Pascal Siakam scored 23 for Indiana, Larry Nance Jr. made five threes, and the Pacers did not have Tyrese Haliburton.

games.headline: Hawks erase a 17-point deficit to beat Nets 124-121
games.story: Brooklyn led 31-14 midway through the first quarter and 37-27 after one. Atlanta outscored the Nets 36-26 in the fourth quarter, the game was tied at 114 with 1:26 left, and the Hawks went ahead on the next play and stayed there. Jalen Johnson scored 30 on 11-of-17 shooting, and Aaron Wiggins and Nickeil Alexander-Walker each had 20. Michael Porter Jr. led Brooklyn with 25, and the Nets committed 22 turnovers.

games.headline: Knicks pull away from Cavaliers for a 109-97 win
games.story: New York went ahead for good at 46-45 in the second quarter after the teams traded the lead 11 times, and it outscored Cleveland 37-26 in that period to lead 63-53 at halftime. The lead reached 19 at 88-69 late in the third. Jalen Brunson scored 31 with 9 assists and Karl-Anthony Towns had 29 points and 13 rebounds. Donovan Mitchell scored 37 for Cleveland, which was without Jarrett Allen, and the Cavaliers made 16 of 50 three-pointers.

games.headline: Thunder rout Wizards 114-75, leading by as many as 43
games.story: Oklahoma City took the lead for good at 17-16 late in the first quarter and led 57-36 at halftime. It stretched the lead to 43 at 114-71 in the fourth quarter, and Washington shot 29 of 98 from the field. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 30 with 9 assists, Jared McCain had 19 on 8-of-10 shooting and Aday Mara scored 18. AJ Dybantsa led the Wizards with 19, and Washington did not have Anthony Davis.

games.headline: Curry scores 41 as Warriors beat Magic 126-119 in OT
games.story: Golden State led by 16 at halftime, but Orlando outscored it 37-20 in the third quarter and went into the fourth ahead 78-77. The game was tied at 110 at the end of regulation. In overtime the Magic led 118-117 with 2:24 left, and the Warriors went ahead 119-118 on the next scoring play and won the extra period 16-9. Stephen Curry scored 41 on 13-of-19 shooting with five threes, and Franz Wagner had 30 points and 11 assists for Orlando, which played without Paolo Banchero.

games.headline: Suns edge Rockets 102-99 after Booker scores 24
games.story: Phoenix led 35-23 after one quarter and by 19 in the second, but Houston outscored it 24-12 in that period and the teams were tied at 47 at halftime. The lead changed hands 17 times, the score was tied at 95 with 4:08 left, and the Suns went ahead 97-95 and held on. Devin Booker scored 24, Jalen Green had 16 and Miles Bridges had 13 points, 10 rebounds and 7 assists. Kevin Durant had 21 points and 10 rebounds for Houston, which shot 36 of 94.

games.headline: Spurs rout Trail Blazers 125-103 with a 35-point lead
games.story: San Antonio scored 42 in the second quarter and 45 in the third, and after a 3-3 tie early it was never behind. It led 64-49 at halftime and 109-74 late in the third, a 35-point margin. Victor Wembanyama scored 29 on 9-of-13 shooting with 7 rebounds, Devin Vassell scored 15 and Stephon Castle had 14 points and 7 rebounds. Deni Avdija scored 15 for Portland, which was without Ja Morant and Shaedon Sharpe.
